newsitem.title: USA: BTG in pact to develop Nasdaq software.
newsitem.headline: BTG in pact to develop Nasdaq software.

text.p: BTG Inc said Wednesday it signed an agreement with the National Association of Securities Dealers Inc's subsidiary NASD Regulation Inc to jointly develop a hardware and software system for Nasdaq's market surveillance.

The information technology company said the new system will enhance Nasdaq's ability to monitor order handling and trading activities. It added a pending rule will require trading firms to report data on specified events in the lifecycle of each order for Nasdaq equities.
BTG's stock traded at 13-3/4 Thursday afternoon, up 1/2.
